command_line: python -I -B scripts/pad_arch_run.py run --config delivery/archrun/pad_arch_run.json --out-root results/archrun --run nuaa_patience_4 --estimator-check results/archrun/20261120-ARCHEST-6c4f9e8 --attempt 1 --i-am-authorized
cap_unit: hours of wall time (elapsed real time, not CPU time)

training.checkpoint: weights of the epoch with minimum val_loss on the dev frames (EarlyStopping restore_best_weights; set_weights when the epochs end first)
training.loss: CategoricalCrossentropy, one-hot labels (index 0 bona fide, 1 attack)
training.class_weight: balanced on the fitting set: n / (2 * n_class)
training.augmentation: RandomFlip(horizontal), RandomRotation(0.03), RandomZoom(0.12, 0.12), RandomTranslation(0.06, 0.06), RandomBrightness(0.15, value_range=(0, 1)), RandomContrast(0.2), GaussianNoise(0.02); fitting set only
training.seeds: train_seed for random, numpy and TensorFlow (weight initialisation, augmentation, batch order); no split seed: the folds and the samples are deterministic

sequence.phase_1: for each of the 24 positions, in order: the fitting and dev frames of the unit assembled; the training (pad_arch_comparison.trial_trainer, the declared copy of the accepted trainer); the checkpoint saved; the training card; for LivenessNet the history check; the dev scored with the saved checkpoint (nuaa_folds_run.tf_scorer), its logits and the val_loss checked against the card; the card and the phase-1 dev scores written
sequence.phase_2: after the 24 trainings, in the same order: for each model the checkpoint reloaded; the ordinary dev scored with the evaluator of PR #27; the agreement with the phase-1 scores checked; the BN statistics re-estimated on its fitting set (copy in memory); the checks of PR #27; the re-estimated dev scored with the same evaluator; the EER thresholds, decisions and counts of both BN states
sequence.reason: a choice of the author: between two trainings the accepted runs (nuaa_session_ablation_run.train_one) scored the dev with the saved checkpoint (nuaa_folds_run.tf_scorer), computed the logits and checked the val_loss, selected the EER threshold, wrote threshold.json and read it back, wrote the dev scores, then assembled and scored the test, wrote the test scores and the card. Phase 1 keeps the same TensorFlow operations except the assembly and the scoring of the test, and keeps the writes of the dev scores (the phase-1 file _dev_scorer.csv) and of the card; it adds the read-back of the thread getters before and after each model and the history check; it leaves out the writing and read-back of threshold.json (the thresholds come from phase 2) and the writing of the test scores. The scoring of the two BN states and the BN re-estimation, which the accepted runs did not do between trainings, are moved after the 24 trainings, so that they add no TensorFlow operation between two trainings. Of the order, PROTOCOL.md §7 says only that 'a ResNet-18 model before it is not measured: the history check of every LivenessNet training is the direct measure'. With the re-estimation in phase 2, a stop in phase 1 leaves every model without its BN states evaluated. Alternatives not chosen: nothing between two trainings, or the re-estimation right after each training

after_stop: a choice of the author: no automatic resume. A run that stops (INCOMPLETE at its cap or by SIGUSR1, MISMATCH, FAIL, or interrupted) keeps its folder and its outcome and is never continued. A new attempt is started only after the outcome has been reported to the coordinator on the C2 card, and is a new process that repeats the 24 positions from position 1 in a new folder; no checkpoint or result of an earlier attempt is reused, so that every training keeps its position in its process; every attempt is reported
test_read: no test frame is assembled or evaluated, no test score or metric is read. What each command reads. check-inputs and run: this configuration; the configuration of the pre-registration; the code files pinned here and this file; the status.json and trial.json of the official trial and the SHA256SUMS of the delivered package that lists them; run_order.csv and run_caps.csv; the configuration of PR #27 (validated) and the configuration of PR #28 (bytes, for its SHA-256); what pad_arch_comparison.load_inputs reads (its TEST_READ): the five M2 manifests (read to index the cache; official_test and cnn_test are NUAA's official lists, not the test role of the folds), the cache, hashed whole with its label and subject members read, the extracted frames file, loaded whole with the SHA-256 of every frame (both frame files also hold frames of the held-out subjects), the cells run (status.json, both SHA256SUMS, its configuration, the cell manifests of the arms and of the common dev), the folds run (status.json, restricted SHA256SUMS, extracted_frames.csv), the LivenessNet architecture file, the configurations, status.json and restricted SHA256SUMS of the two accepted runs and the card arm_b_fold1_seed42 of the run at patience 4; in addition the 12 training cards of arm B of each accepted run (history and keys of the fitting and dev frames); with --estimator-check, the status.json and estimator_check.json of a check-estimator record. run, in addition: the image arrays of the cache, loaded whole into the frame store; of all the frames it assembles only the fitting and dev frames of arm B (an explicit check refuses any other role); it reads back its own checkpoints. check-estimator: this configuration, the configuration of the pre-registration (for the threads) and, through pad_arch_comparison.load_config, the configurations of the two accepted runs, the code, the official trial record and the package SHA256SUMS, run_order.csv and run_caps.csv, the configurations of PRs #27 and #28 (both validated), what nuaa_bn_recalibration.load_inputs reads (the same M2 manifests, cache and extracted frames file, loaded whole, the cells run, the status.json, restricted SHA256SUMS and extracted_frames.csv of the folds run, the revised note of PR #27, the architecture file, and of the parent run at patience 4 status.json, both SHA256SUMS, its public aggregate.json only as bytes for the SHA-256 (it holds test metrics, never parsed), and per model card, dev scores, threshold and checkpoint), of the run 20261114-BNRECAL-a10a082 what nuaa_bn_test.load_bnrecal reads (status.json, both SHA256SUMS, public results.csv and run_record.json, restricted public_SHA256SUMS.sha256, per model _scores.csv and _bn_statistics.json, which hold dev and fitting rows only); it assembles only fitting and dev frames.
